rationale: C24 plausibly supplied the child’s concrete drafting template. It uses the same statutory quotation, the same finding by the Secretary after notice and a hearing, a numbered list of newly covered drugs, and an almost verbatim operative proclamation declaring the listed drugs addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining like morphine and making the finding effective immediately. C04 is similarly close, while C19 additionally parallels the child’s parenthetical exclusion of a dextrorotatory form and its salts.

shared_material.parent_excerpt: Whereas section 4731 (g) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1954 provides in part as follows: OPIATE.—The word "opiate" ...
shared_material.explanation: The child and C24 reproduce the same governing statutory provision in substantially identical language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the Secretary of the Treasury, after due notice and opportunity for public hearing, has found that each of the following-named drugs has an addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine, and that in the public interest this finding should be effective immediately
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the Secretary of the Treasury, after due notice and opportunity for public hearing, has found that each of the following-named drugs has an addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine, and that in the public interest this finding should be effective immediately
shared_material.explanation: This entire factual and procedural predicate is shared verbatim and introduces a numbered drug list in both directives.

shared_material.child_excerpt: do hereby proclaim that the Secretary of the Treasury has found that each of the aforementioned drugs ... has an addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine and that in the public interest this finding should be effective immediately
shared_material.parent_excerpt: do hereby proclaim that the Secretary of the Treasury has found that each of the aforementioned drugs has an addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine and that in the public interest this finding should be effective immediately
shared_material.explanation: The operative provision follows C24’s wording and sequence almost exactly, with only the child’s drug-specific exception inserted.
